reason: Changes preserves exact repository and recorded-turn snapshots, hydrates only their own bounded sides, and exports recorded patches with explicit file routing.
remoteDefaultSelection: origin first; remaining git remote order
first available remote; no HEAD fallback

gitScopes.branch: merge-base(HEAD, selected base) to working tree
gitScopes.uncommitted: HEAD or empty tree to working tree
gitScopes.staged: HEAD or empty tree to index
gitScopes.commit: parent or empty tree to selected commit

lastTurnSelection: latest available turn with recorded changes, all repositories; no live Git substitution
snapshotIdentity: Resolved scope and repository-qualified path, including rename relation and exact before/after object or content identities.
fullContents: Read resolved Git/index/working sides only when requested, retain original raw patches, and never substitute live files for historical patches.
generatedFileMetadata: Explicit Git attributes may filter presentation; unavailable attributes never suppress coherent changes or snapshot identities.
patchTransport: Repository patches retain canonical Git paths, fixed context and raw metadata. Recorded copy transport binds one proven file to quoted a/b paths while keeping original hunks, modes, object IDs and binary payloads; unprovable transports report patchCopyUnavailable without hiding the recorded diff.
richContents: Verified bounded snapshot media remain available when encoded patch transport truncates. Complete recorded SVG sides may preview; unavailable historical media never reads current files.
